days.title: Dev story: our menu said CAN CEL

x.text:
Our pause menu said CAN CEL. Not a typo: the font pulled some letter pairs closer and not others, and our wide letter spacing turned that into a gap.

Steam Demo in 9 days

#madewithunity #WeLoveIndies

tiktok.text:
Our pause menu said CAN CEL. The spelling was fine. The font pulls some letter pairs closer and leaves others alone, and under our wide letter spacing the one it skipped looked like a space. So we turned kerning off on spaced-out labels. Steam Demo out 3 Dec.

#indiedev #strategygame #indiegame #gamedev

rules.xHashtags: At most 2 hashtags per X post: #madewithunity on every post, plus #screenshotsaturday on Saturdays, #wishlistwednesday on Wednesdays once the page is live or the day before, otherwise #WeLoveIndies.
rules.xStyle: X captions: one short hook line (a satisfying, curious or funny moment, never an ad), then the countdown as a small second line, then 2 hashtags. From the examples Chris Zukowski shares (Paralives: Resize, flip and stack!).
rules.youtubeHashtags: YouTube descriptions end with #indiegame #madewithunity; the title keeps #Shorts. TikTok keeps #indiedev #strategygame #indiegame #gamedev.
